messages:
Liam O'Connor: Hi! New hire here (started today). My USB-C dock powers the laptop fine but my Dell U2720Q isn't showing any signal. Dock is the company one with two video outs. Any quick checks? Also the monitor in the onboarding tracker still says 'labelled' not dispatched \u2014 who should I tag for that?

IT - Priya: Welcome Liam :wave: Quick checklist: 1) Confirm dock firmware LED is solid green. 2) Swap the DisplayPort/HDMI cable with the other port on the dock. 3) Apple menu > About This Mac > System Settings > Displays > press Option to show Detect Displays. If you can, paste output of `system_profiler SPDisplaysDataType` (short is fine).

Liam O'Connor: LED is green. Tried port swap, no change. Detect Displays didn't pop anything. system_profiler snippet: `Graphics/Displays: Intel Iris Plus Graphics: Display VendorID: 1133 DisplayProductID: 516`

IT - Priya: Huh, that output shows the internal GPU but not the external. Two possibilities: bad cable or dock firmware mismatch. Do you have another USB-C cable you can test? Also try connecting the monitor directly to the Mac with the monitor's USB-C (if it supports alt-mode).

Liam O'Connor: I tried my personal USB-C cable and it actually shows the external monitor for a second then flickers away.

Rachel (People Ops): @Liam tagging logistics. We shipped a monitor yesterday; let me check status. If you need something now, Theo in Facilities has a spare on 3rd floor.

Logistics Bot: Package RDW-881122 status: labelled -> with courier (label printed), last updated 2025-07-08 14:02 UTC, est_delivery 2025-07-10.

Theo - Facilities: Hey Liam, I can drop a spare Dell U2720Q at your desk in ~20 mins. If Priya wants to swap a dock while I'm there we can isolate it.

IT - Priya: If it shows for a second on a different cable then likely the dock's DP/HDMI mux is flaky. @Theo if you could bring a spare dock that'd be ideal. Liam, also open a ticket with IT (brief subject: "external monitor not detected") so we can log serials and follow up. I'll field the swap when you're at desk.

Liam O'Connor: Thanks all. I'll grab the spare today and file the ticket now. Ticket #IT-20345 created. Appreciate the quick help! :thumbsup:
